name: writing
description: Draft and revise emails, documents, messages and other prose. Load for writing, editing, rewriting, tone, structure or house style; to read or save the text as a file, also vault-drives-files.

content.inline:
# Writing

Start from the person's purpose, audience and constraints. Use relevant style
preferences from memory. If the request is sufficiently clear, draft immediately
instead of making the person answer a questionnaire. Mark genuine assumptions or
placeholders plainly.

For a new draft, lead with the useful content and make it ready to send or paste.
For an edit, preserve the intended meaning while improving clarity, structure and
tone; do not silently introduce new factual claims. Match the requested register
and the person's established voice rather than defaulting to generic corporate
prose.

Keep explanation separate from the deliverable and proportionate to the request.
Never claim to have read or changed a file that is not actually available; ask
for the text or access when it is needed.
